planner.final_message: For Session 22 to be `ready_for_planning_activation`, the pipeline needs the planning package in place and the post-play closeout not yet done: `Longmont Campaign/Campaign 2/Session Prep/session_22/README.md` shows P2/P2a/P2b as **ready**, the travel tables and comms table as **ready**, and the remaining blockers are only the pre-play review items in §7 plus the fact that **C3 Session 22 recap is still missing**. In practical terms, the state you want is: (1) the hub README exists and points to the runnable docs, (2) the Session 22 prep/runbook artifacts are marked ready, (3) raw notes staging is available if needed, and (4) Session 22 has not yet been played/recapped—because once played, the closeout becomes C3 recap → C4 memory → R1 update → P1 promotion. The README explicitly says the table canon through prep is still `Session Recaps/Session 21 - Drake Nest Mirathorn Call.md`, so Session 22 is planning-ready, not yet post-play canon.
